name: Sewanee: The University of the South
tuition_note: Private (single rate for all students). 2025-26 tuition $57,916 + activities fee $310 = $58,226 tuition & fees, from e-catalog.sewanee.edu/arts-sciences/admission-expenses-financial-aid/tuition-fees/.
